ITEM 1. BUSINESS

NVIDIA pioneered accelerated computing to help solve the most challenging computational problems. We specialize in GPUs, DPUs, and full-stack software platforms powering AI supercomputing.

sections.title: Item 7. MD&A
sections.content:
ITEM 7. MANAGEMENT'S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS

Fiscal year 2024 was a transformative year. Total revenue increased 126% to $60,922 million, driven by exceptional growth in our Data Center platform following the enterprise inflection point for generative AI.

Gross margin expanded significantly to 72.7% from 56.9% in fiscal 2023, reflecting higher Data Center architecture sales.
